infoPlist.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: BPM Coach plays songs from your Apple Music library and adjusts their tempo to match your heart rate.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: BPM Coach connects to your Whoop to read live heart rate during workouts.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: BPM Coach uses GPS to measure your running pace.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: BPM Coach keeps measuring your pace while your phone is locked during a workout.

plugins.motionPermission: BPM Coach uses motion data to measure your running cadence.
